Join me on an exciting wildlife adventure as we explore the Rajgir Nature Safari in Bihar. Located in the picturesque town of Rajgir, this nature safari offers a unique opportunity to spot exotic wildlife and experience the natural beauty of Bihar.
In this video, we'll take you on a thrilling ride through the safari, showcasing the diverse range of flora and fauna that call this place home. From majestic animals to vibrant birds, we'll get up close and personal with the incredible wildlife of Rajgir.
